entry.author: RotoruaNZ
entry.summary:
Rotorua was buzzing with energy over the weekend as the National Cheerleading Competition took over the Energy Events Centre 🤸‍♀️✨

From tiny tumblers to elite teams, the talent, teamwork and spirit on display were incredible to watch. It’s inspiring to see such a prestigious national event choosing Rotorua as its stage 🙌

📸| Captured by @whenumckinnon
